name: UkrOboronProm

what_it_is.prose: UkrOboronProm (State Concern Ukroboronprom) is Ukraine's state defence-industrial conglomerate, the parent grouping for a large portfolio of Ukrainian defence and aerospace enterprises — most relevant here, the Antonov aircraft company. Its connection to India runs mainly through Antonov's role as OEM for the Indian Air Force's An-32 fleet and through repeated efforts to deepen aerospace cooperation: Ukroboronprom and Antonov offered India co-production of the An-132 light transport and pitched the An-178, and Ukrainian officials publicly sought expanded aerospace collaboration. These initiatives have not translated into major standing India contracts for the conglomerate itself, and the An-32 upgrade relationship (run via Antonov) was disrupted by the Russia-Ukraine war. This is a compact (Tier C) card: as a foreign conglomerate, its documented India footprint is largely proposals plus the indirect Antonov/An-32 support link, with limited India-specific primary evidence of realised programmes.

variant: Tier C compact card (Antonov parent conglomerate)
open_questions: Whether any Ukroboronprom/Antonov India co-production offer (An-132, An-178) will be realised is unresolved.
The conglomerate's post-reorganisation structure and current India engagement during the war are not fully documented in sources reviewed.
